hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *backend/*.py) ruff format "$f" && ruff check --fix "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *frontend/*.ts|*frontend/*.tsx|*frontend/*.js|*frontend/*.jsx|*frontend/*.css) npx --no-install prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null || npx prettier --write "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
